assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
CPT 93247 is long-term continuous electrocardiographic monitoring
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9, Z86.73)
The note states that long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The monitoring study was billed under CPT 93247
The denial is based on precertification/prior authorization not being obtained
